solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Make intelligible point, after censure

indicators.note: the point is placed after the censure, so it comes second

parts.note: to decry is to censure or condemn openly

explanation.surface: A demand to make a criticised argument clearer, a point raised after a telling-off.
explanation.definitionFit: Decrypting a coded message turns it into plain readable text, so it makes it understandable.

clue.text: Diabolical arrest shortly after protest

indicators.note: the arrest follows the protest

parts.note: a demo is a protest march

indicators.note: cut short means the last letter of the word is dropped

parts.note: to nick someone is slang for arresting them

explanation.surface: A wicked police arrest right after a demonstration.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shortly' looks like 'soon', but it shortens NICK to NIC.
explanation.definitionFit: Devilish or fiendish, like a demon from hell.

clue.text: Scoundrel, with promises of redemption — that's unusual

parts.note: a cur is a contemptible man
IOUs are promises to pay a debt, to be redeemed later

explanation.surface: A rogue offering IOUs to buy his way back: how strange.
explanation.definitionFit: Curious can mean odd or strange, not just eager to know.

clue.text: Cry of joy from unruly type

definitions.meaning: first meaning: an exclamation of delight
second meaning: a boorish, rowdy person

explanation.walkthrough: The Yahoos are the brutish humans in Gulliver's Travels, hence a lout.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is both a whoop of delight and a term for an uncouth lout.

clue.text: Great fear after it enters unknown area

indicators.note: going in means it sits inside the fear

parts.note: terror is great fear
Y is an unknown quantity in algebra

explanation.surface: Panic sets in once something ventures into uncharted land.
explanation.definitionFit: A territory is a region or tract of land, an area under some control.

clue.text: Error that's dangerous on flight

parts.note: a wrong footing on a flight of stairs is a literal false step, and the word also means a mistake in general

explanation.walkthrough: 'Flight' suggests an aircraft, but here it is a flight of stairs, where a false step can cause a fall.
explanation.definitionFit: A wrong step taken while walking, and figuratively any blunder or mistake in conduct.

clue.text: So-called lady married the first man to appear

parts.note: Adam is the first man in Genesis

explanation.surface: A woman wedded the earliest man to show up.
explanation.walkthrough: A woman is addressed as 'madam', hence so-called.
explanation.definitionFit: Madam is the polite form of address for a woman, what a lady is called.

clue.text: E.g. bloody weapon hidden in clothes? Just the opposite

indicators.note: concealed within signals one piece going inside another
reverses the stated order, so the clothes go inside the weapon

parts.note: a sword is a weapon
wear means clothing, as in menswear

explanation.surface: A bloodstained blade concealed under someone's garments.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bloody' looks like a gory adjective, but it is an example of mild British cursing.
explanation.definitionFit: Bloody is a mild British expletive, an example of an oath or rude word.

clue.text: One vehicle or another heading North on peak

indicators.note: in a down answer, on means placed above
in a down clue going upwards means the word is read backwards

parts.note: a cart is another kind of vehicle
a tor is a rocky hill or peak, as on Dartmoor

explanation.surface: A vehicle of some kind heads north up a mountain.
explanation.definitionFit: A tractor is a farm vehicle used for pulling machinery.

clue.text: Drug healthy, we hear, for depression, in a way

parts.note: pot is slang for cannabis

indicators.note: said aloud, the word for healthy sounds like another word

parts.note: whole means healthy, as in hale and whole

explanation.surface: Drugs and wellbeing, said to be a cure for depression of a kind.
explanation.walkthrough: 'depression' reads as low mood; here it is a hollow in a road, 'way' meaning road.
explanation.definitionFit: A pothole is a hollow worn in a road surface, a dip in a roadway.

clue.text: Person protesting getting royalty after a month

indicators.note: the royalty comes after the month in the answer

parts.note: March is a month of the year
ER, Elizabeth Regina, stands for royalty in crosswords

explanation.surface: A demonstrator gets royal attention a month on.
explanation.definitionFit: A demonstrator who walks in a protest procession is one who marches.

clue.text: The German players moulded, in a way

parts.note: die is the German definite article (feminine and plural)
a cast is the group of players in a production

explanation.surface: German actors shaped somehow, as if their performance were fixed.
explanation.definitionFit: Die-cast metal is shaped by forcing it into a mould, one particular method of moulding.

clue.text: Monies distributed, including record coinage

indicators.note: the reworked letters take the record inside them
spread around means these letters are shared out into a new order

parts.note: the letters of monies are the fodder
a log is a written record, as in a ship's log

explanation.surface: Money handed out, with a record kept, as though about coins being issued.
explanation.walkthrough: 'coinage' and 'Monies' suggest money, but coinage here means inventing a word.
explanation.definitionFit: A newly coined word or expression is a neologism; coinage here is invented vocabulary, not money.

clue.text: In operation nine to five, say

indicators.note: the answer sits inside the word that follows, so it is lifted out of it

parts.note: the word that holds the answer within it

explanation.surface: Something running during office hours, nine to five.
explanation.walkthrough: 'nine to five' reads as working hours, but here it is a proportion, like 9:5.
explanation.definitionFit: Nine to five is an example of a proportion between two numbers, written 9:5.

clue.text: Constant requests for quantities of alcohol

parts.note: C is the usual symbol for a constant in science
asks means requests, as a verb

explanation.surface: Someone keeps on asking for more and more drink.
explanation.definitionFit: Barrels of beer or wine, each a measured amount of drink held in a wooden container.

clue.text: Two parts of old LP are diverting

definitions.note: a verb in -ing form; the answer is the base verb meaning divert

parts.note: the clue's 'Two parts of old LP' asks for two components of a vinyl record; the first is a side
the second component of an old vinyl album is a track, one song on it

explanation.surface: The two halves of a vinyl album are entertaining.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Two' asks for two different parts of a vinyl album, SIDE then TRACK. 'diverting' reads as entertaining, but it means distracting, with 'are' the link.
explanation.definitionFit: To sidetrack is to distract someone from the main issue, turning them aside.

clue.text: Needless to say, imprisoning fellow that's gone astray

indicators.note: locking up means the phrase holds the fellow inside it

parts.note: of course is an idiom for needless to say

explanation.surface: Of course a man held in prison went wrong somewhere.
explanation.definitionFit: A ship or plane off its planned route has wandered from the right way, like something straying.

clue.text: Doctor settled if check needed in operating area

indicators.note: to doctor is to tamper with, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: the letters of these two words form the fodder

explanation.surface: A medic sorted out a check needed in the operating theatre.
explanation.walkthrough: 'operating area' suggests a hospital, but it means the real-world setting where equipment operates.
explanation.definitionFit: A field test is a trial carried out under real working conditions rather than in a lab.

clue.text: Composed by old poet, characteristic of what comes from the heart

definitions.text: characteristic of what comes from the heart

indicators.note: put together suggests the following letters are arranged afresh

parts.note: the letters of these three words form the fodder

explanation.surface: A heartfelt piece written by some poet of the past.
explanation.walkthrough: 'what comes from the heart' sounds like sincere verse, but it is literally the blood the heart pumps.
explanation.definitionFit: Blood is pumped out by the heart, and its group (A, B, O and so on) is one property it has.

clue.text: Moving quickly and taking over

definitions.meaning: first meaning: ... along is travelling fast and smoothly
second meaning: in cricket the bowler delivers the six balls of an over

explanation.walkthrough: In cricket an over is a set of six deliveries by one bowler, so 'taking over' is not seizing control.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means rolling swiftly along, and also delivering balls in a cricket over.

clue.text: Be in supervisory role, as bishop is

definitions.meaning: second meaning, read as two words: a bishop is over a see, his diocese

explanation.walkthrough: A see is a bishop's diocese, so a bishop is literally over his see.
explanation.definitionFit: To oversee is to supervise and manage, and split it describes a bishop above his diocese.

clue.text: Cause current stoppage without union, in fact

indicators.note: in its old sense of outside, so the stoppage goes around the union

parts.note: to dam a river is to stop its current
TU is short for trade union

explanation.surface: Union-free action to halt an electric current, given as a fact.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' looks like 'lacking', but here it has its old sense of outside, so the stoppage wraps around the union.
explanation.definitionFit: A datum is a single piece of information, a given piece of data.

clue.text: Moves with pained expressions after short time

indicators.note: the cries follow the time

parts.note: T is the abbreviation for time
ouches are cries of pain

explanation.surface: Someone shifts, groaning in pain, after a brief moment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Moves' looks like motion, but means stirs emotionally.
explanation.definitionFit: To touch someone is to affect them emotionally, as a moving story does.

clue.text: Famous singer to perform in unexpected benefit

indicators.note: the performance goes inside the windfall

parts.note: manna from heaven is an unexpected windfall
to do is to perform

explanation.surface: A star singer appears at a surprise charity gig.
explanation.definitionFit: Madonna is a famous American pop star, the 'Queen of Pop'.

clue.text: The thing that contains energy — cereal

indicators.note: holding means the energy goes inside

parts.note: what can mean the thing, as in 'what I need is rest'
E is the symbol for energy in physics

explanation.surface: Something packed with energy turns out to be a breakfast grain.
explanation.definitionFit: Wheat is a grain crop, one of the main grasses grown for food.

clue.text: Conservative has to keep secret before spring

indicators.note: the secret-keeping comes first, then the spring

parts.note: to hide is to keep something secret
a bound is a leap or spring

explanation.surface: A Tory must hush things up ahead of a spring election.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone hidebound is rigidly traditional and resistant to change, narrow-minded in outlook.

clue.text: Female entertaining the French — her beauty captivated Paris

indicators.note: playing host to means the French article goes inside

parts.note: a hen is a female bird
le is French for the

explanation.surface: A woman hosting the French: her looks won over the capital.
explanation.walkthrough: Paris is the Trojan prince who carried off Helen of Troy, not the French capital, though 'the French' points that way.
explanation.definitionFit: Helen of Troy, famed for her looks, was abducted by the Trojan prince Paris.

clue.text: Stop working for nobleman

parts.note: to bar is to stop or block
on means working, as a switched-on machine

explanation.surface: An order to cease work for a lord.
explanation.definitionFit: A baron is a member of the lowest rank of the peerage, a titled aristocrat.

clue.text: Put in position at home to play for time

parts.note: in means at home, as in 'is she in?'
to stall is to delay deliberately

explanation.surface: Someone stays in to put off doing something.
explanation.definitionFit: To install equipment is to fit it and set it in place ready for use.

clue.text: Introduce article to make from clay

indicators.note: bringing in tells us the article goes inside the word for make

parts.note: to make money is to earn it
the is the definite article

explanation.surface: Instructions for putting an item into a pot made of clay.
explanation.definitionFit: Earthen pottery is made of baked earth, so an earthen pot is fashioned out of clay.

clue.text: In treating her kindly, one may end up in a pickle

definitions.text: one may end up in a pickle

indicators.note: the answer lies within the next words, running across them

parts.note: the run of letters spanning these words holds the answer

explanation.surface: Being nice to her could still land you in trouble.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in a pickle' looks like trouble, but taken literally it is a jar of preserved vegetables.
explanation.definitionFit: A small cucumber that is pickled in vinegar, so it literally finishes up preserved in brine.

clue.text: In a suit, oddly, in African country

indicators.note: strangely means the letters of the preceding words are arranged differently

parts.note: these three words supply the letters

explanation.surface: Someone dressed in a suit, looking odd, somewhere in Africa.
explanation.walkthrough: 'oddly' tempts you to take the odd letters, but it signals a rearrangement of all seven letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Tunisia is a North African nation on the Mediterranean, capital Tunis.
